description:
Cast Ashling's Command by paying {3}{U}{R}, choosing its fourth mode targeting yourself and then any of the other three modes.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trgger.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, pairing it and Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Ashling's Command.
Resolve the copy of Ashling's Command, causing you to create two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Activate Naru Meha by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
Repeat from step 3.
